title: Counter-Strike: Linx Legacy Esport vs STATE (BO1) - Dust2.dk Ligaen Regular Season
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike match between Linx Legacy Esport and STATE in the Dust2.dk Ligaen Regular Season, initially scheduled for October 26, 2026 at 4:00 PM ET.

This market will resolve to "Linx Legacy Esport" if Linx Legacy Esport win the match against STATE.

This market will resolve to "STATE" if STATE win the match against Linx Legacy Esport.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or ends in a tie, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before November 9, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of October 26, 2026 at 4:00 PM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.
